test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shakila incurs a loss of 10% after selling a machine part for Rs 540. In order to gain a profit of 10%, at what price should Shakila sell the same part?
solution:
Given: 

Loss% = 10

Selling price of machine = Rs. 540

Calculation:

Cost price = selling price + 0.90 cost price

⇒ 0.90 cost price = 540

⇒ CP = 540/0.90

⇒ 600

To earn a 10% profit selling price = 1.1 cost price

⇒ SP = 1.1 × 600

⇒ Rs. 660
